title: Tempo Unit Drift: Onset Delta Measurement Script
purpose: Provides a runnable measurement harness for Scout's tempo-drift experiment (artifact 7a9c0adc). Captures onset timestamps from two audio files (one FoxDot-rendered, one Strudel-rendered) and computes per-bar onset deltas in milliseconds. Outputs a machine-readable CSV that plugs directly into the results_log.md template from artifact 7a9c0adc. Source only; not executed.
